vision.preprocess: AutoProcessor: resize/center-crop to 224, CLIP mean/std. The q8 ONNX graph requires both text and image inputs in one session; dummy text '.' or an 8×8 blank image is passed for the unused tower. Independent probes confirmed text_embeds do not change with the dummy image and image_embeds do not change with the dummy text.

models.fusion: l2-average of Chinese-CLIP caption text and image vectors in the same space

H1.hypothesis: 外观问句：视觉检索 recall@5 应高于字幕/标题文本检索

H2.hypothesis: 属性问句：文本检索 recall@5 应不低于视觉检索

H3.hypothesis: 以图搜图：视觉应把目标属性相同商品排进 top5；仅用查询图字幕不应轻易打平

H4.hypothesis: 融合向量在 H1/H2 上相对纯图、纯文本的 recall@5（预期不确定）

H5.hypothesis: 单元测试覆盖对齐约束，且不下载视觉模型
H5.note: 由 pnpm test 覆盖，不在本评测脚本中跑模型
